scope: Standard NHL full-game markets only. Operator must verify jurisdiction, market header and void exceptions before using an offer.

nhl_full_game_ot_so.label: Includes overtime and shootout
nhl_full_game_ot_so.description: Game bets (moneyline, puck line, total) are graded on the final score including overtime and the shootout; a shootout win adds one goal to the winning team's score.

nhl_player_ot_no_so_participation.label: Overtime counts, shootout does not; void if the player doesn't play
nhl_player_ot_no_so_participation.description: Player props count statistics from regulation and overtime, not the shootout. The player must take part in the game; a player who does not play is void, not a loss.

pending.fanatics: verification in progress; until it is complete, Fanatics prices are shown but treated as unverified.
